verdict.rationale: Audit logging is a fair question for a SaaS collaboration platform like Slack, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of an audit log of admin and user actions. The only nearby items are a help-page keyword list mentioning 'access logs' and workspace data export docs, which cover a different capability (data export, not audit logs). Admin approval of MCP clients is an adjacent control, not audit review.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can review audit logs of admin and user actions across the workspace
